# Import and analyze Metagenome-Assembled Genomes (MAGs)

## Set up

```{r}
#| label: load packages

library(Biostrings)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Import data

``` {r}
#| label: upzip files

# Unzip the MAG sequences into the mags folder
unzip("molecular/genomics/mags/bin.010.fasta_assembly.zip", exdir = "molecular/genomics/mags/")

# Unzip the metadata into the metadata folder (if it downloaded as a zip)
unzip("molecular/genomics/metadata/bin.010.fasta_assembly.json.zip", exdir = "molecular/genomics/metadata/")


```
